name: Warbow
body:
Benefit: A warbow is essentially a very powerful composite longbow. Because of its length and power, it is considered an exotic weapon. Like a composite bow, a warbow has a particular Str rating. Each point of Str bonus adds 125 gp to its cost. The warbow is a two-handed weapon.

Adventuring Classes: A Fistful of Denarii. Copyright 2009, Robert J. Grady. All rights reserved.
